questions.question: The two types of reproduction are ________.
The following are parts of the female reproductive system EXCEPT ________.
________ is the contamination of our environment with dirty, poisonous, dangerous or hazardous substances.
The following are examples of air pollutants EXCEPT ________.
Which of the following can cause land pollution?
The following are ways of controlling water pollution EXCEPT ________.
options: D. Dumping untreated sewage into water bodies

questions.question: Persistent sores and other serious infections may occur when a person's immune system is severely weakened by ________.
The correct full meaning of STI is ________.
Which of the following is the best way for young people to prevent sexually transmitted infections?
options: C. Early treatment of identified cases

questions.question: The following may be symptoms associated with advanced HIV infection EXCEPT ________.
Which of the following statements is true about HIV?
options: A. HIV can always be completely cured
B. HIV can be transmitted by hugging
C. HIV is the cause of every fever
D. An infected pregnant woman can transmit the virus to her baby

questions.question: HIV can be transmitted through the following ways EXCEPT ________.
options: C. Use of contaminated sharp objects

questions.question: Gonorrhoea is caused by ________.
Pesticides and herbicides may be responsible for which type of pollution when they contaminate the soil?
The following are control measures for air pollution EXCEPT ________.
options: A. Locating industries away from densely populated areas
B. Educating people on the dangers of air pollution

questions.question: A person living with HIV can always be identified by looking at his or her face.
The ability to do work is referred to as ________.
The following are natural sources of energy EXCEPT ________.
The SI unit of energy is ________.
Which of these devices converts electrical energy mainly into kinetic energy?
________ energy comes from resources that can be naturally replaced as they are used.
The type of pollution commonly associated with respiratory disorders is ________.
An electric pressing iron converts electrical energy into ________ energy.
The kind of energy stored in the food we eat is called ________ energy.
The organ in the female reproductive system which houses the developing baby until birth is called the ________.
A bicycle dynamo converts ________ energy into electrical energy, which can then produce light.
The type of reproduction practised by humans is ________ reproduction.
The male sex cell is called ________.
Dirty, poisonous, dangerous or hazardous substances that contaminate the environment are called ________.
The release of harmful or poisonous gases into the atmosphere causes ________ pollution.
Which of the following is the female sex cell?
The fusion of male and female gametes is called ________.
The product formed immediately after fertilization is called a ________.
Which of the following is an example of asexual reproduction?
Which organ produces the female reproductive cells?
Which of the following is NOT a type of environmental pollution?
Oil spillage mainly affects ________.
Dumping refuse into rivers can cause ________.
One effective way of controlling land pollution is ________.
Bush burning contributes mainly to ________.
Which of the following is an example of a sexually transmitted infection?
Which of the following does NOT transmit HIV?
options: D. Transmission from an infected mother to her baby

questions.question: Sharing unsterilized sharp objects can increase the risk of transmitting ________.
Which of the following is a responsible way of preventing the spread of infections?
A person cannot know another person's HIV status simply by ________.
options: A. Looking at the person's appearance

questions.question: Energy from the sun is called ________ energy.
Which of the following is a renewable source of energy?
Which of the following is a non-renewable source of energy?
An electric bulb converts electrical energy mainly into ________ energy.
A generator converts mechanical energy into ________ energy.
A loudspeaker converts electrical energy mainly into ________ energy.
The energy possessed by a moving object is called ________ energy.
Energy stored in an object because of its position is called ________ energy.
The law of conservation of energy states that energy cannot be ________.
options: B. Converted from one form to another

questions.question: Which of the following is a use of energy in the home?
Coal, crude oil and natural gas are examples of ________ sources of energy.
Which of the following can help conserve energy?
options: A. Switching off electrical appliances when not in use
B. Leaving lights on throughout the day

questions.question: Which of the following is a land pollutant?
Untreated sewage discharged into a river may lead to ________.
options: D. Increased oxygen in the water

questions.question: Which of the following practices helps to keep the environment clean?

essay.title: SECTION B - THEORY
